runs.t: Reading Comprehension 1: Read the passage and answer questions 641 to 645.

The invention of the internet has completely revolutionized the way we communicate and access information. Before the internet, people relied heavily on traditional media such as daily newspapers, television broadcasts, and radio for the news. Researching a specific topic required physical trips to the library and hours of looking through heavy encyclopedias. Today, with just a few clicks, we can access a vast amount of information on almost any subject imaginable.

The internet has also transformed personal and professional communication. Email and social media platforms allow us to stay connected with friends, family, and colleagues around the world instantly. However, the internet also presents new challenges, such as the rapid spread of misinformation and growing concerns about online privacy. It is absolutely essential for users to critically evaluate the information they find online and take steps to protect their personal data.

Reading Comprehension 2: Read the passage and answer questions 646 to 650.

Artificial Intelligence (AI) is rapidly becoming an integral part of our daily lives. From virtual assistants like Siri and Alexa to recommendation algorithms on streaming services, AI technology is specifically designed to make our daily tasks easier and more efficient. In the healthcare sector, AI is currently being used to analyze complex medical images and assist doctors in diagnosing severe diseases with high accuracy. In transportation, self-driving cars powered by AI aim to significantly reduce road accidents caused by human error.

Despite its numerous benefits, the rapid rise of AI also raises several serious ethical questions. There are growing concerns about job displacement as machines become increasingly capable of performing tasks traditionally done by human workers. Additionally, the complex issue of bias in AI algorithms needs to be addressed urgently to ensure social fairness. As AI continues to evolve, society must carefully navigate these challenges to maximize its positive impact while minimizing potential harms.
